entries.mitigation: Tank blocks the frontal flurry and keeps Overfiend faced away from the group.
Stop pushing boss health and clear each add wave before triggering the next one.

entries.entry_name: Flesh Atronachs — Ibomez the Flesh Sculptor
entries.mitigation: Prioritize Flesh Atronachs so their pressure does not accumulate around the boss.
Move out of the large spin AoE so the group is not knocked into the poisonous water.
Kill the surrounding Necromancers before committing to boss burn so skeleton pressure does not snowball.
Tank the Abomination near the arena edge and preserve the center for group movement.
Keep repeated interrupts on the healer bodyguard while the other Council members are killed.
Tank and stack all four bodyguards while keeping melee frontals away from the group.
Avoid every Darklight Burst and keep clean access to portal positions.
Enter the assigned portal and use the synergy during the fall to survive the lethal transition.
Clear zombies with AoE before they accumulate and crowd the group's assigned spacing.
Use separate positions behind the boss so targeted mechanics are obvious and do not overlap.
Interrupt the healer guard repeatedly while the other two guards are focused down.
Focus the tank guard first, then the damage guard, then the healer while all three remain controlled.
Players whose screens turn greyscale immediately destroy the portals before reinforcements enter.
Spread around the boss and step clear of personal fire bursts rather than stacking them together.
Stay near the middle of the room and rotate with the lightning wall; Hard Mode makes the wall substantially faster.
Kill the shielding adds to remove Kena's immunity, but move clear of each add's lethal death explosion before re-engaging.
